loop: Cloud-landmark camera registration; one-second tail/head blend; source first frame appended twice before 30->60 fps optical-flow interpolation so the final frame is the true 324->0 midpoint; last output frame trims to 650 frames
interpolation: ffmpeg minterpolate (mci motion estimation, aobmc, vsbmc) at source resolution before upscaling
enhancement: Light temporal denoise, Lanczos resize to 4K, CAS + mild unsharp for crisp edges; original palette, painted texture and motion preserved; no AI-generated detail
